# Turkcell Enhances Services with Affirmed Networks

## Partnership Overview
- **Date:** 15 Apr 2020  
- **Companies Involved:** Turkcell (Turkey), Affirmed Networks (US)  
- **Objective:** Introduce new revenue-generating services and improve customer connectivity.  
- **Affirmed CTO:** Ron Parker emphasized the benefits of the platform for Turkcell.  

## Implementation Details
- **Previous Collaboration:** Turkcell and Affirmed completed a unified Network Function Virtualisation (NFV) infrastructure in Q1 2019.  
- **Current Virtualization Status:** Turkcell has virtualized 60% of its mobile core services on its telco cloud.  
- **Unique VNFs:** The infrastructure features 20 unique virtualized network functions (VNFs).  
- **Future Goal:** Turkcell aims to reach 75% virtualization by the end of 2020.  

Turkcell's collaboration with Affirmed Networks is set to significantly enhance its service capabilities.  

---  

## Benefits of the New Platform
- **Service Creation:** Allows Turkcell to create new network slices.  
- **Enterprise Support:** Helps enterprise customers onboard and provision new customer premise equipment.  
- **Subscriber Services:** Enables quick, seamless, and reliable deployment of new subscriber services.  

The new platform is expected to streamline service delivery and improve customer experience.
